environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'org-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with BLOCK action, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (VPC endpoints only for ECR/logs), and CloudWatch metric filters trigger on WAF blocked requests.

config.load_balancer: ALBv2 with HTTPS listener, TLS 1.2 minimum
config.waf_rule_priority_5: Custom rule group 'org-input-validation': RegexPatternSet on QueryString values, pattern covers UNION-based, stacked queries, and tautology injections, action BLOCK
config.waf_rule_priority_10: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet, default actions (BLOCK on Log4j, path traversal, etc.)
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, VPC endpoints for AWS services only
config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on WAF BlockedRequests > 0 triggers SNS alarm
